name: an-unseen-warning-is-not-recorded-as-waved-away
find: guard presented?.kind == expected else { return nil }
replace: guard presented?.kind != nil else { return nil }
breaks: a dismissal meant for the refusal is recorded against the code folder warning behind it, so the launch check that runs on every activation treats a warning nobody saw as one Dan waved away and stays silent for the rest of the session (#855)
